Club: Kendo.description:
🗡️ You are a member of the U.A. Kendo club.

🗓️ It meets after classes on Monday, Wednesday, Friday, in the Main Gymnasium.
🤝 Itsuka Kendo runs it; Ectoplasm is the advisor.
📈 Grants: Melee Weapons +5. Practice counts as training.

Say "I quit the club" to leave it.
Club: Kendo.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is a member of the U.A. Kendo club, run by Itsuka Kendo with Ectoplasm as advisor; it meets after classes on Monday, Wednesday, Friday in the Main Gymnasium. The lead and members know they are a member (never ask them to sign up again). Going to practice is the player's choice each time; a missed practice is fine, a habit of missing gets one honest word from the lead. Club time is real time: an afternoon at the club is an afternoon not spent elsewhere.
